context: PubMed's free full text subset is the set of PubMed records that NCBI E-utilities marks with the query free full text[sb]. Resolve each paper to a PMID: a pmid is used directly; a doi must match exactly one PubMed record; a title must match exactly one PubMed record after normalizing both sides (case-insensitive, whitespace collapsed, trailing period removed). A paper that resolves to no record, or whose record is not in the free full text subset, is left out. Keep the input order and remove duplicates by the same kind and normalized value, keeping the first occurrence; different identifiers that name the same article are not duplicates. The free full text status comes from live PubMed data.
